Our Story

Our culture, our ideas, our practices, our environmental concern and our team work lead us to creating superior values for people and communities around us.

S.P.Babu Vijay

Managing Director

Indu Housing Development

In 2000, Chennai gained a builder who chose trust over the hard sell.

Indu Housing Development was founded by Shri S.P. Babu Vijay on a simple belief: give honest advice, not a sales pitch. That principle has shaped every villa, house and apartment we've built since — no pressure, no overpromising, just straight answers about what a home will actually cost, take and become.

Our journey
Where it started2000

Shri S.P. Babu Vijay founded Indu Housing on one principle: honest advice over hard selling. Twenty-three years later, that principle hasn't changed.

Homes across the City2000 – 2025

39 residential projects delivered across Chennai: villas, individual houses and apartments. Each one is planned and built with our in-house civil engineers and architects.

Indu Coral, Besant NagarOngoing, 2026

TNRERA-registered, 40 residences in Besant Nagar — our current project on Chennai's coast. Stilt + 5 floors, with 2 and 3 BHK homes built for coastal living.

Two decades of building, one story worth telling

From a single promise in 2000 to a TNRERA-registered project on Chennai's coast today.
